original.target_description: Original full paper not acquired within the per-paper acquisition window.

replication.target_description: Study 1, crowd-size photo selection: Republicans versus Democrats (including leaners), chi-square test of incorrect selections.

n.sample_role: Participants: 422 Republicans and 532 Democrats, including leaners; full post-exclusion sample for Hypothesis 1.
n.exclusions: Excluded survey duration <5 or >60 minutes, age <18 or >100, duplicate IP, and non-USA IP; complete data for 1018 before exclusions.
n.quote: After exclusions, the final sample included 954 participants

reported_success.quote: we replicated the central finding of Schaffner and Luks (2018)

notes: Original unavailable independently of replication. Replication uses current partisan preference rather than 2016 vote; p. 4 locator selects Hypothesis 1. Test statistic retained as printed; no metric conversion.
